0022600132.text: Miami comes into this road game, its fifth of the 2026-27 season, at 0-4 on a four-game losing streak and sits 15th in the East, 3 games back in the Southeast. Atlanta is 2-2, 7th in the East and 2nd in the Southeast, 1 game back, on a two-game losing streak. Heat players Pelle Larsson (ankle sprain) and Simone Fontecchio (illness) are both day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, while Hawks players Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture) are both out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Heat won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 143-117 win in Miami on April 12, 2026.
